PC-POL-012.explanation: Required insurance is 80 percent of $500,000, or $400,000. Carried divided by required is $300,000 / $400,000 = 0.75, so the insurer pays 0.75 x $100,000 = $75,000.

PC-POL-024.explanation: When the insurer cancels, the insured receives the full unearned portion in proportion to time remaining. Short rate, which keeps a penalty, applies when the insured cancels, as in the Virginia standard fire policy (Va. Code § 38.2-2105).

PC-AUTO-017.explanation: UIM responds when the at-fault driver's liability coverage is less than the damages, up to the insured's UIM limits. In Virginia it is paid on top of that liability coverage unless a named insured elects to reduce it (Va. Code § 38.2-2206(A)). A driver with no insurance triggers UM rather than UIM.
